observations.first_failed_contract: The caller promises finite grip/anchor inputs at f64 level without establishing finite f32 values at the later typed boundary.
trace: 95e item_catalog_validation.rs:703–724 accepts finite nonnegative f64 grip_to_tip_m and, when present, three finite signed f64 anchor_offset_m components. item_catalog_schema.rs:74–85 stores those fields as f32. A source value of 1e100 is finite as f64 but exceeds f32 range; negative 1e100 is also permitted for signed anchor offsets.

Pinned serde_json 1.0.151 value/de.rs:169–193,282–314 and number.rs:535–546 route an f64 number to a visitor when arbitrary_precision is not enabled; serde_core 1.0.229 impls.rs:222–242,450–456 casts f64 to f32 without a finite check. The typed preflight in item_catalog_validation.rs:269–273 discards this result; build.rs:260–275 emits the original Value rather than the typed result.

At runtime item_catalog.rs:27–31 deserializes the embedded original JSON and expects success. With serde_json float_roundtrip enabled, de.rs:345–353,623–635,1512–1513 parses f32 in single precision and rejects infinite result, so a qualifying retained oversized literal can yield an error at the expect. With float_roundtrip disabled, de.rs:109–125,319–335,638–653,1508–1510 selects the f64 numeric route, whose f32 visitor can instead produce infinity.

95e adventuresim-weapon-model/Cargo.toml:8–10 requests float_roundtrip and adventuresim-core/Cargo.toml:21–28,32–39 declares runtime and build serde_json dependencies; complete host/target feature resolution remains unproved.

If an infinite value is retained and projected without instance replacement, player_projection.rs:812–829 copies it into TacticalEquipmentPhysical; inventory.rs:199–208 marks nonfinite grip/anchor invalid, and server/equipment.rs:504–523 refuses the selected drop before collider creation. Separate fallback visual and grab targeting source reads show anchor usage but do not establish that these paths run.

observations.safeguards: positive_f32_in correctly guards the fields that invoke it; f32-validity guard exists in TacticalEquipmentPhysical. Signed anchors and zero grip values can be intentional; do not clamp, blanket-reject zero, or require offsets to be positive.

Review whether to retain the typed preflight value or perform equivalent validation without changing output formats; do not choose a repair here.

nonfindings: positive_f32_in rejects missing, nonnumeric, nonfinite, nonpositive-after-cast and over-maximum source values; tiny positive inputs that round to zero fail this helper.
finite_in permits zero where its callers set zero minima. Do not convert every finite ratio or nonnegative value into a positive quantity.
The full P16 and 95e helper bodies contain no test blocks. Additional support source snippets were only read as source.
